description: Header file defining the MPSHooksInterface class for MPS backend integration in PyTorch, including function declarations that fail if MPS is not present.

classes.name: MPSHooksInterface
classes.description: Interface class for MPS backend hooks, with methods that fail if called without MPS support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MPS library state; fails if MPS backend is not present.

methods.name: hasMPS
methods.description: Returns false indicating MPS support is not available.

methods.name: isOnMacOSorNewer
methods.description: Checks if running on MacOS or newer; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns default generator; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Returns a new generator; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getMPSDeviceAllocator
methods.description: Returns MPS device allocator; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes device; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: commitStream
methods.description: Commits stream; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getCommandBuffer
methods.description: Returns command buffer; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getDispatchQueue
methods.description: Returns dispatch queue; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties cache; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns current allocated memory; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getDriverAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns driver allocated memory; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getRecommendedMaxMemory
methods.description: Returns recommended max memory; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets memory fraction; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: profilerStartTrace
methods.description: Starts profiler trace; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: profilerStopTrace
methods.description: Stops profiler trace; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Acquires event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Gets device from pointer; fails if called without ATen_mps library.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries event; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: elapsedTimeOfEvents
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between events; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: hasPrimaryContext
methods.description: Checks for primary context; fails if called without MPS backend.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if pointer is pinned; returns false.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns pinned memory allocator; fails if called without MPS backend.
